federation.title: GEORGIAN EQUESTRIAN FEDERATION
federation.subtitle: Event Support & Organising Team
bullets: Provided direct support to multi-time Georgian Champion and 2-time World Cup Qualifier Shalva Gachechiladze.
Served as an official Judge across all federation competitions.
Managed full-scale venue setup and live event execution for all events.
Built Official Georgian equestrian Federation website, managing real-time competition data and official results for every event.

courseDesigner.title: FEI COURSE DESIGNER EXPERIENCE
courseDesigner.subtitle: Working with International Course Designers
bullets: Assisted Ivo Mikulič (FEI Course Designer) at multiple annual World Cup Qualifiers.
Worked with Olaf Scholz (FEI Course Designer) on technical course layouts.

steward.title: FEI STEWARD
steward.subtitle: Official Steward at Competition
bullets: Participated in international and national competitions as an official FEI Level 1 Steward.
Ensured adherence to animal welfare standards and fair play under Chief Steward Jani Pavlovski.

riding.title: RIDING & HORSE HANDLING
riding.subtitle: Rider and Horse Experience
bullets: Regular riding and horse handling experience.
Active participant in show jumping and equestrian training.
